description: This Dart file implements a SplashScreen widget that loads initial menu data asynchronously and navigates to the home screen once ready. It manages state to show a loading indicator during initialization.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays a splash/loading screen and initiates menu loading upon creation.

classes.name: _SplashScreenState
classes.description: State class managing loading logic and navigation for SplashScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and starts the loading process.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Performs asynchronous menu loading and navigates to the home screen when complete.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying a loading indicator.
